title: knoxia lineata
intro: Knoxia lineata, commonly known as the 'Yellow Chay,' is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including health benefits such as reducing inflammation and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Knoxia lineata include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in developing new treatments for various diseases.
